note: Firm baseline compliance rules, as data. The supervision console edits these at runtime and the next evaluation uses them. Advisor and client layers may enable and tighten, never disable a mandatory rule or soften one. Citations are to real rules; thresholds are the firm's choice within them.

rules.title: Retail communication crossing the pre-approval threshold

params.label: Retail investors in a rolling 30 days
params.note: Rule 2210(a) sets 25. A firm may supervise below it; it may not supervise above it.

rules.finding: This note reaches {recipientCount30d} retail investors in a rolling 30 days, over the {threshold} threshold, so it is a retail communication and needs principal approval before use.
rules.remediation: Route to a principal for pre-use approval, or reduce the distribution below the threshold.

rules.title: Correspondence not reviewed under written supervisory procedures

params.label: Review sample rate for non-recommendation correspondence
params.note: Correspondence is reviewed, not pre-approved. Recommendations are reviewed every time.

rules.finding: Correspondence carrying a recommendation has not been through supervisory review.
rules.remediation: Queue for review under the written supervisory procedures. Pre-approval is not required at this distribution.

rules.title: Business conducted on an uncaptured channel

params.label: Minimum record completeness
params.note: The industry has paid billions in fines for exactly this. The firm default is total coverage.

rules.finding: {gapChannels} in use with nothing capturing them. Record completeness is {completeness}.
rules.remediation: Connect a capture source for each channel, or prohibit the channel and attest to it.

rules.title: No retained copy behind a captured channel
rules.finding: {partialChannels} captured but held by no system of record. Evidence exists and retention does not.
rules.remediation: Point the channel at the archive, which is the 17a-4 copy, by WORM or the audit-trail alternative.

rules.title: Recommendation without a documented reasonable basis

params.label: Reasonably available alternatives on record
params.note: Reg BI requires reasonably available alternatives, not all of them. The rule does not itself mandate documenting the analysis; this is the firm's evidence standard.

rules.finding: Recommendation lacks complete care-obligation evidence: {alternativesConsidered} alternatives on record against a standard of {minAlternatives}.
rules.remediation: Complete the rationale record before release: basis, reasonably available alternatives, costs compared, why this client.

rules.title: Performance or testimonial content in advisory-capacity material
rules.citation: SEC Rule 206(4)-1, Advisers Act marketing rule
rules.finding: Client-facing text contains performance projection or testimonial content.
rules.remediation: Remove it. The firm blocks projections in client-facing drafts entirely while the FINRA projections proposal is unadopted.

rules.title: Possible diminished capacity or financial exploitation

params.label: Specified adult age
params.note: Rule 2165 defines a specified adult as 65 or older, or 18 plus with a reasonable belief of impairment.

rules.finding: Specified adult aged {clientAge} with an exploitation indicator present.
rules.remediation: Escalate for a hold decision under Rule 2165 and confirm a trusted contact is on file.

rules.title: Unlogged client complaint
rules.finding: Client message reads as a grievance and no complaint record exists.
rules.remediation: Log it in the complaint register and route per the firm's complaint procedure.

rules.title: Holdings drifted outside the stated profile

params.label: Single-name concentration ceiling
params.note: A client IPS may set a tighter ceiling. It may not set a looser one.

rules.finding: {instrument} is {concentrationPct} percent of investable assets against a ceiling of {maxConcentration}.
rules.remediation: Document the rationale for holding, or propose a bounded reduction from the approved shelf.

rules.title: Client identifying data on an unapproved channel
rules.finding: Client identifying information sent over an unapproved channel.
rules.remediation: Recall is not possible. Record the incident and assess notification under the amended safeguards rule.

rules.title: Generated client-facing text released without grounding
rules.citation: FINRA Regulatory Notice 24-09; 2026 Annual Regulatory Oversight Report, GenAI

params.label: Minimum citations in generated client text
params.note: Existing rules apply to AI tools. Grounding is the firm's evidence that they did.

rules.finding: Machine-drafted client text with {unsourcedFigures} unsourced figures and {citationCount} citations.
rules.remediation: Block release. Every quantitative claim must trace to a cited passage or a computed value.

rules.title: Undisclosed outside business activity signal
rules.finding: Message suggests an outside business activity with nothing on file.
rules.remediation: Confirm with the advisor and collect a disclosure if one is owed.
